observations.finding: 棚光和自然光中，上部封闭石墨饰板与下方黑色进气开口都能明确区分。前部白色鼻端包角有真实曲面，宽黑楔形仍是强烈的视觉组成。
observations.remainingLimit: 鼻部的宽直外轮廓仍偏硬，没有照片级比例验收。

observations.area: 肩部与外轮廓 / shoulder and silhouette
observations.finding: 肩部高光的过渡较原窄硬折展开，外形和轴距/轮廓身份保持，车轮层次更清楚。
observations.remainingLimit: 门侧和部分翼子板外缘仍有较大平面，改动不能被解释为完整重拓扑或 CAD 复刻。

observations.finding: 两个光照条件都能看到较细的分叉轮辐、窄金属边和浅碟气动片。以前宽大的深色叶片不再占据同样大的轮面区域。
observations.remainingLimit: 自然光下金属仍随现有 HDR 呈较强综合色，未做实测 BRDF 标定。

observations.finding: 上部喷口、下层风道、固定件、支柱与围板有不同深度，安装关系较旧版整片背板更可读；实验座椅背面现在确实存在。
observations.remainingLimit: 外侧后围仍黑且偏硬，隐藏结构是项目作者的布局，不代表厂方结构载荷验证。

observations.finding: 原来上半部的不透明黑窗观感消失，仪表台后方金色弹簧舱不再透出，方向盘移到左侧。原先背面剔除造成悬空安全带的问题在本次 2d88 图中已消除，左前景现在可见座椅背面。
observations.remainingLimit: 座椅、内饰缝线和屏幕形体仍简化；玻璃内外 alpha 差异是已披露的视觉近似。

observations.finding: 两版各自原始渲染页面的同条件补图保留双座身份，原车与实验单座区分清楚；玻璃反光、轮面层次、左舵和仪表台遮挡变化可见。
observations.remainingLimit: 这些 PNG 的元数据由前后两次独立状态导出关联，不冒充同帧原子条件；车内座椅仍明显为参数化简模。

observations.area: 主页面驾驶座舱 / real driving camera
observations.finding: 晴天和湿夜都能从真实风挡看到前方道路、天空/天际线及街道底层；方向盘、仪表台、窗框在真实三维前景，没有通过隐藏整车取得视野。湿夜仪表台可由现有环境光读出形体。
observations.remainingLimit: 这是流畅档、暂停、同点的可视性检查，不证明持续行驶、全部视野方向、硬件 GPU 帧率或整城夜景验收。小屏为继承的静态外观，实时驾驶指标由 HUD 提供。

observations.finding: 从驾驶员视角经既有相机循环返回环绕后，整车完整显示，未遗留隐藏外壳。该图近处深色矩形已由城市代理按源码/投影核为既有钢检修盖板。
observations.remainingLimit: 这是单独 UI 截图，不是同帧条件 ZIP；盖板缺少识别细节导致黑块观感，本结论不外推用户旧版未定位图。

diagnostics.otherMessages: The raw log retains generic 404 console text without attached URLs, SwiftShader ReadPixels stall messages, lack of KHR_parallel_shader_compile and PMREM sigma sample-count warnings. No missing-image claim is inferred from the generic errors.
diagnostics.deploymentIdentityLimit: The unpublished localhost candidate had no deployment.json. The embedded final model/build identity and unchanged served source hashes were checked. Public deployment identity requires the separate publish verification.

driverExportObservation.scope: The application panel values were read from separate UI screenshots. Browser harness durations include actual WebGL work, automation and browser save latency, and are not the application serializer duration.

limits: Actual WebGL 2 frames were produced with independent Headless Chrome 155.0.8059.84 / ANGLE SwiftShader software rendering. No hardware GPU performance acceptance is claimed.
The 24-frame technical matrix renders the frozen 3.15 model with the current renderer; it is not the complete old renderer pipeline.
The eight stock images use the actual original 3.15 and current 3.16 inspection pages. Their state bracketing is explicitly non-atomic.
The two main cockpit frames are paused balanced-preset illustrations using the actual existing physics state and visible cabin.
Visible styling improvements do not establish OEM CAD, measured materials, regulatory visibility, structural strength, full-city coverage or completed 3A production quality.

integrationContext.integratedReleaseStatus: Vehicle inspection inheritance verified; final city pixels and publication identity remain separate release evidence.
integrationContext.inspectionInheritanceStatus: Verified to c12a by native static-import parsing and all captured/target source hashes. model-build.js identity metadata is an explicit byte-change exception. Original image labels remain unchanged.
integrationContext.inspectionScope: 32 renderer PNGs retained: 28 original 2d88 inspection-renderer frames and four original 3.15-page frames. All geometry/material/light/camera modules, markup/styles, and loaded HDR are unchanged; these are not newly captured c12a pixels.
integrationContext.cityCockpitScope: Two city cockpit frames and four independent UI screenshots retain their original 2d88 snapshot identity and are excluded from this inheritance assertion. Final city cockpit captures are produced separately.
